//product: The Blinkit product to track. prid is the number at the end of the URL.
//location: Your coords are SECRET (they reveal your home) -> set LAT / LON in the .env file, NOT here. They are sent as the lat / lon headers, from which Blinkit picks the dark store.
//notify: Your ntfy topic is SECRET (it is the only password on free ntfy.sh) -> set NTFY_TOPIC in the .env file, NOT here. Optionally override the server with NTFY_SERVER.

notify.//remindEveryMinutes: Keep nagging while it stays IN STOCK: re-ping at most every N minutes. 0 = only alert on the out->in-stock transition. Checks run every ~11-13 min, so any value below ~10 effectively means 'ping on every check'.
notify.//heartbeatHour: Send one push per day at/after this hour (local time; set TZ in docker-compose): low-priority 'still watching' while checks work, 'checks FAILING' when the last good check is over 3 h old. -1 disables. If you ever stop getting it, the tracker is dead.
notify.//failureAlertHours: If every check fails for this long, push one warning (reset on the next good check).

//watch: When the next check runs: each --once run writes now + intervalMinutes (+/- jitterSeconds) to data/next-run for run-loop.sh. intervalMinutes between checks; jitterSeconds randomizes timing a little so it does not look robotic.
//api: The stock check is one POST to Blinkit's product API through curl-impersonate. impersonate is the browser fingerprint it sends (a target the pinned binary in the Dockerfile ships, e.g. chrome150); if Cloudflare starts answering 403, try a newer target. timeoutSeconds bounds one request.
